# C++/WinRT header subset

This subset is generated by Microsoft Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0, C++/WinRT 2.0.250303.1. It contains the transitive `winrt/` headers needed by `graphics_capture.hpp` and `windows_graphics_capture_smoke.cpp`, so Linux Zig cross-builds use the same declarations as Windows MSVC builds. The headers are unmodified; see `LICENSE.txt` (MIT).
